description:
Our Renderer has 17 tests. Upstream `tui-render.test.ts` is
510 lines (port-map §14.5). Gaps to port:

- **Cursor tracking on shrink**: when content goes from N
  lines to M<N, the cursor moves to M (not stays at N). Our
  code does this implicitly via CSI but there's no test.
- **Spinner-in-middle detection**: a single middle line
  changes while surrounding lines stay — diff should emit
  only the middle.
- **Stale-content clearance**: a component inflates maxLines
  then shrinks; stale rows below get cleared with `\e[K`.
- **Transition content → empty → content** — the renderer
  treats each as a separate frame.
- **Full-redraw on component branch switch** — different
  layout entirely.
- **Styles reset after each line** — no italic/bold bleed.
- **Viewport upward move on large shrink** forces a full
  redraw.

Plus a resize-during-render race test:
- Issue resize + render back-to-back; the resize's
  invalidation must take effect on the next render.

TDD:
- Port each scenario from tui-render.test.ts into ExUnit.
- Add the resize-race test with GenServer.call interleaving.
title: Renderer test coverage + upstream tui-render.test.ts parity
